card.name: The word committee in organization names
card.fires_on: The word "committee" (or "Committee") when it names a specific official body, usually right after a modifier like national, preparatory, constitutional or executive. It appears in political and historical web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Named committee after a modifier
modes.description: Committee ends a title such as a national, executive or preparatory body.

modes.label: Committee set up for a task
modes.description: Lowercase committee describes a body formed to draft or study something.
